about: The go/no-go gates for two launches (doc: docs/securax/release-readiness.md). 'open' is the public launch of the free core; 'paid' is charging for an edition. A gate is a PROBE (worked out from the repository every time, never typed in) or an ATTEST (something only the owner can confirm: a repository setting, a lawyer's letter; it needs a date and where the evidence is). A probe that fails carries open_since, a queue id and a due date, so nothing is failing quietly; fitness 'release-gates' fails a probe that goes red without that record, and a record left on a gate that is green. ./securax release ready prints the verdict; the release workflow refuses a 1.0.0 or later tag while an 'open' gate is NO-GO.

launches.open: the public launch of the free core

flows.what: a copy of the person's Life OS data, sealed on the device before it leaves, and the Microsoft sign-in itself
flows.when: only after the person taps to connect their own OneDrive
flows.to: the person's own Microsoft account; SecuRAX never receives it
flows.protection: sealed on the device (the key stays there); the narrowest folder permission

flows.what: nothing goes out; bank alert mails are read into the device
flows.when: only after the person taps to read alerts from their own mailbox
flows.to: the device; SecuRAX never receives it
flows.protection: read-only permission, taken away with one switch

flows.what: the person's Life OS data, to the person's own machine
flows.when: only on a device they paired with their own estate
flows.to: a machine the person runs; SecuRAX never receives it
flows.protection: same-origin calls to the estate; TLS on the estate's own names

flows.what: a push subscription and short alert texts
flows.when: only after the person allows notifications
flows.to: the person's own estate, then the browser maker's push service
flows.protection: Web Push encrypts the message for the device; the push service sees only an address

flows.to: the gateway on their own estate; sensitive text stays on local models
flows.protection: the gateway's rails, identity, allowance and audit chain

flows.what: what any web server sees: the address of the device and the page asked for; and the person's own e-mail if they write to us
flows.when: on opening the site or the hosted app, or sending a mail
flows.to: the static host and our mailbox
flows.protection: no cookies, no analytics, no scripts from elsewhere (gate no-trackers-no-foreign-code)

advice_wording_reviewed.why: an employer's matching contribution to a provident or pension account, which is a term of employment, not a market return
the interest no longer paid after a loan is repaid, which is arithmetic, not a market return

advice_wording_reviewed.phrase: Sell vested stock on a fixed rule
advice_wording_reviewed.why: a general rule against holding one's income and savings in one employer; it names no security and no price

gates.title: Every push and pull request is scanned for secrets over the whole history, and the same scan runs before a commit
gates.why: one leaked key in a public repository is copied within minutes

gates.title: No key file, environment file or vault content is tracked
gates.why: the scanner reads text; a key store or a private workbook must simply not be there

gates.title: The owner ran a full-history secret scan, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection is on
gates.why: a repository setting cannot be read from the code
gates.how: Settings, Code security: turn on Secret scanning and Push protection; run gitleaks detect over a full clone; rotate anything it finds

gates.title: A release carries a list of its parts (SBOM), checksums and signed build provenance, and is published only after every file is attached
gates.why: a person must be able to prove a download came from this repository

gates.title: Every build step written by someone else is pinned to an exact commit, not a movable tag
gates.why: a hijacked tag on a step that can publish a release would ship a tampered build with a valid signature
gates.fix: replace each third-party uses: owner/name@vN with the full commit and a comment naming the version; Dependabot keeps them current

gates.title: No workflow runs a stranger's code with write access or secrets, or pastes a stranger's text into a shell
gates.why: a public repository receives pull requests and issues from anyone

gates.title: Every bundled part made by someone else ships with its licence, and the release lists the apps' parts too
gates.why: the text reader bundled in the Life OS is under a licence that must travel with it; the SBOM covers only the gateway image
gates.fix: add THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md (the bundled text reader and its language data, the two typefaces), put each licence text beside its files, and add a source SBOM step to the release

gates.title: Python, JavaScript, container and build-step dependencies are watched for updates
gates.why: an unpatched dependency is the commonest way in

gates.title: The docs show a person how to check a download before running it
gates.why: a signature nobody is told how to check protects nobody

gates.title: main is protected (required checks, no force push), the owner account uses a passkey or hardware key, releases are immutable, private vulnerability reports are on, and a second person can act if the owner cannot
gates.why: one account is today the single way a bad build reaches every user
gates.how: Settings, Rules: protect main; Settings, General: immutable releases; Settings, Code security: private vulnerability reporting; name the second maintainer in MAINTAINERS.md

gates.title: A contribution from anyone else carries a sign-off that it is theirs to give
gates.why: code of unknown origin cannot be sold, and cannot become MIT in two years
gates.fix: a sign-off (DCO) check on pull requests from anyone but the owner and the bots

gates.title: Every threat model is complete: all six ways considered, each threat mitigated with proof, accepted with a reason and a date, or ruled out
gates.why: a model with a gap is a part nobody has attacked on paper; a review date that passes turns the fitness check threat-modelled red by itself

gates.title: The hosted apps run on an origin of their own, with security headers that the host really sends
gates.why: today they share one browser origin with every other project of the account and the host sends no headers, so another page there could read a person's stored data; that host's terms also do not allow a paid service
gates.fix: queue own-origin-hosting: a host that reads website/_headers, on our own name; then close the two accepted threats in the hosted-apps model

gates.title: The parts strangers will reach have a threat model: the AI gateway, the sync hub, the installer and update channel, and the release pipeline with its build agent
gates.why: these four cross a trust boundary and have no model in governance/threat-models.json
gates.fix: one model each (doc 133), ids as in required_models

gates.title: Payments and the paid entitlement have a threat model before they are built
gates.why: money and a licence check are the first things attacked in a paid product
gates.fix: a model with id billing-entitlement before any payment code

gates.title: As a guest, and with a profile but nothing connected, the Life OS sends nothing off its own origin on any screen
gates.why: the promise that data stays on the device needs a test, not a sentence

gates.title: No app or page loads a script, style or font from another site, and none names an analytics or advertising service
gates.why: a third-party script reads everything the page can read

gates.title: Every outside address in the apps' code belongs to a declared flow: what leaves, when, to whom, how it is protected
gates.why: the privacy notice is written from this list, so the list must be complete

gates.title: A privacy notice is published and linked from the README and the site
gates.why: India's DPDP Act (section 5) and the GDPR (article 13) both require a clear, itemised notice from whoever decides how personal data is used; we do for the site, mail and support, and for billing later
gates.fix: PRIVACY.md written from the flows above, with the parts doc release-readiness section 5 lists; the owner and counsel approve the wording

gates.title: A person can take all their data out and erase all of it, on the device, and a test holds both
gates.why: access, portability and erasure are rights under both laws; on the device they must not need us

gates.title: The DPDP obligations are mapped and checked against the gazette text
gates.why: the map covers only the breach clock and is marked unverified; the core duties apply from May 2027
gates.fix: queue dpdp-map: notice, consent, rights, grievance, breach, children, retention, each with its evidence; confirm the dates against the gazette

gates.title: The legal person who answers for personal data and grants the licence is named, with a grievance contact that is answered
gates.why: a notice, an invoice and a licence each need a named party
gates.how: queue licence-holder-company; then name it in LICENSE, PRIVACY.md and TERMS.md

gates.title: The owner decided whether the paid edition is offered to people in the EU or UK, and acted on it
gates.why: offering it there brings the GDPR with it (article 3): a representative in the Union, transfer terms and a contract with each processor
gates.how: decide yes or not yet; if yes, appoint the representative and sign the processor contracts; if not yet, say so in TERMS.md and do not price or advertise there

gates.title: No screen tells a person to buy, sell or hold a named investment, promises a return, or calls SecuRAX an adviser
gates.why: that is the line between education with tools and investment advice under SEBI's adviser rules

gates.title: No app reads a market price feed
gates.why: SEBI lets education use only price data that is at least 30 days old; no feed, no question

gates.title: No link to a financial product carries a referral or affiliate tag
gates.why: a commission is payment for steering people to a product

gates.title: Wherever money guidance shows, the person can see it is education and tools, not advice for them, and that SecuRAX is not a registered adviser
gates.why: the Life OS gives rules of thumb beside the person's own numbers (a share in equity by age, a cover range from income) with no such line on screen
gates.fix: one catalog line under the Stack, the Wealth and Vantage money screens and the site's pricing; wording in doc release-readiness section 6

gates.title: The Ask screen's money, insurance, tax and legal personas explain and teach; they name no product and are not called advisers
gates.why: they are told to act as a personal-finance advisor and an insurance advisor and to give an opinion on the person's own case; an AI doing that for a fee is advice by another name
gates.fix: rename those roles to guides, and add to their instruction: explain the options and the trade-offs, name no specific security, fund, policy or price, and say what to ask a registered professional

gates.title: A securities lawyer confirmed in writing that the paid edition stays outside the adviser and research-analyst rules, or said how to register or partner
gates.why: planning on a person's own numbers, for a fee, is the fact pattern those rules were written for; only counsel can clear it
gates.how: send counsel doc release-readiness section 6 and the screens; keep the letter in the vault and its date here

gates.title: No storefront page calls the current version open source
gates.why: the licence is source-available (FSL), and each version becomes MIT after two years; calling it open source today would be a false claim

gates.title: One disclaimer page covers security, compliance maps, money and tax, health, AI answers and authorised use of the testing tools, linked from the README and the site
gates.why: each of these is said in one place or another, or nowhere; a person must find them in one
gates.fix: DISCLAIMER.md with the six parts in doc release-readiness section 7; the owner and counsel approve the wording

gates.title: Terms for the paid edition are published: price and renewal, cancelling and refunds, liability, governing law
gates.why: India's e-commerce consumer rules and the dark-pattern guidelines require these before a person pays
gates.fix: TERMS.md with the parts in doc release-readiness section 7, approved by counsel

gates.title: The name passed a clearance search and the application is filed
gates.why: a name that must change after launch costs every user their trust in which copy is real
gates.how: queue ip-trademark; keep the search report and the filing receipt in the vault

gates.title: SECURITY.md says where the real SecuRAX lives, how to check a copy, and how to report a fake one or misuse
gates.why: an app that holds a family's money facts will be cloned by people who want those facts

gates.title: The features that read a person's messages are modelled against being set up on someone else: a partner, a parent, an employee
gates.why: forwarding bank messages and reading a mailbox are also what stalkerware does; neither model considers it
gates.fix: add the threat to estate-sms-inbox and life-os-bank-mail, with a visible sign on the device that it is on, and one switch off

gates.title: The AI gateway has tested limits: an allowance per person, refusal of foreign origins, and a human in command
gates.why: a free AI door is drained or misused within hours of being found
